description: FindCamp gives neutral fit verdicts for European campsites, built from analysed public comments. Ask whether a specific campsite suits how you travel — family, light sleeper, beach, nature, quality, dog, or couple — and get a clear fit or no-fit, two or three reasons, and one honest tradeoff. It can also shortlist campsites for a profile or compare two side by side. FindCamp is a decision layer, not a booking site: it helps you decide, then points you to the campsite.
